ashen.name: Ashen Threshold
ashen.desc: A scorched rift full of swarming scouts. The first trial for new pilots.
voideye.name: Void Eye
voideye.desc: A watching anomaly. Medium-class hunters with a heavy guardian every ten waves.
crown.name: Abyssal Crown
crown.desc: The throne of the deep aliens. Heavy waves and raid bosses: bring a squad.
nexus.name: Dread Nexus
nexus.desc: A war-torn breach the deep hives defend as one. Built for a full clan squad of eight: every boss of the deep is waiting inside. The waves never change, so a clan can plan every one of them.
